title: Experiments SMP Items
description: Experiments SMP Items add custom items meant for the roleplay server Experiments SMP
body:
This is a mod for the roleplay Experiments SMP! It adds various items inspired by the QSMP server.

 

Experiments SMP Items adds various items meant to enhance the immersion of people playing with it. With custom armor like gas masks and custom plushies of characters.

 

Item List

- Risus Potion
Block List

- Plush Cucurucho
- Blank Egg Plush
- Plush Chayanne
- Plush Tallulah
- Plush Trumpet
- Play Bobby
- Plush Richarlyson
- Plush Leonarda
- Plush Tilin
- Plush Dapper
- Plush Pomme
- Plush Juanaflippa
- Plush Codeflippa
- Plush Sunnysideup
- Plush Pepito
- Plush Empanada
- Plush Chunsik
- Plush Nacho
Armor List

- Gas Mask
 

The mod will be occasionally updated to add more content, such as special beds and plushies. for egg characters
